summary: The CI nextest profile kills a test still running after 10 minutes and fails it (TIMEOUT), in CI and in local scripts/st-test runs alike; scripts/ci-linux's tests stage holds the bound and shows on a scratch crate that a hang is killed

compatibility.detail: No product behaviour change. .config/nextest.toml and scripts/ci-linux are rust-tests global inputs, so every crate key changes once: each open pull request runs or re-signs all of rust-tests once after merging main.
